## MYCOPLASMA PNEUMONIAE
Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See
diagnosis/syndrome section for more information.
## Preferred treatment
## Inpatient

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 to 14 days ($) [DI]
Alternative
Intolerance to doxycycline and azithromycin
Levofloxacin 500 mg PO q24h for 5 days ($) [R,DI]
## Outpatient

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 to 14 days ($) [DI]
Non-VA order for above
Alternative
Azithromycin 500 mg PO x 1 ($) on day 1, then 250 mg PO QD ($) for 4 days
Non-VA order for above
Intolerance to doxycycline and azithromycin
Levofloxacin 500 mg PO QDay for 5 days ($) [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above
References:
Mandell Chapter: Mycoplasma pneumoniae and Atypical Pneumonia
Sanford keyword: Mycoplasma pneumoniae
Up-to-Date article: Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection in adults
